facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith, who is out of metal. In exchange he keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and plays it every night while they are gone.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor. Warwick holds Sir Phidipaldi's plate armor and lyre as collateral.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves the damage he takes from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance, blocking the party from getting metal for Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has already bashed partway into it.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether Dunk's bashing opened a passable way into the mine.
